evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox with no image or video generation model, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, scored by three VLM judge panels.
